remarks.para: Provides information for Constructors, Types, Methods, Properties and Fields.
The object reflection properties are set using the methods: SetAssembly(), SetConstructorInfo(), SetFieldInfo(), SetMethodInfo(), SetPropertyInfo() and SetTypeReference().
Once the reflection properties are set, the Syntax strings can be retrieved with the syntax methods: Get*Syntax();

ParmNames.summary: Gets parm names from method info.

ParmTypeNames.summary: Gets parm method type names with parm names.

SetAssembly.remarks: Sets the FileSpec property value and attempts to set the Assembly property value if the assembly exists.

SetConstructorInfo.remarks: Sets the MethodName property value and attempts to set the ConstructorInfo property value if the type reference and constructor with the correct parameters exist.

SetFieldInfo.remarks: Sets the FieldName property value and attempts to set the FieldInfo property value if the type reference and the field exist.

SetMethodInfo.remarks: Sets the MethodName property value and attempts to set the MethodInfo property value if the type reference and method with the correct parameters exist.

SetPropertyInfo.remarks: Sets the PropertyName property value and attempts to set the PropertyInfo property value if the type reference and the property exist.

SetTypeReference.remarks: Sets the TypeName property value and attempts to set the TypeReference property value if the assembly reference and type name exist.

GetConstructorSyntax.summary: Creates and returns the Constructor syntax.

GetFieldSyntax.summary: Creates and returns the Field syntax string.

GetGenericTypeSyntax.summary: Creates and returns the Generic Type syntax.

GetMethodSyntax.summary: Creates and returns the Method syntax.

GetPropertySyntax.summary: Creates and returns the Property syntax string.

GetTypeSyntax.summary: Creates and returns the Type syntax.

IsProperty.summary: Indicates if the Method is not a property getter or setter.
IsProperty.returns: true if not a Property; otherwise, false.
